task.title: P6-097: Profile catalog first load before scoping a performance fix
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 8 — Performance). Original id: P6-097. Size: M, measure first. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/catalog-search.md.

**Catalog first load is slow — profile it before scoping a fix.** The only item in this file a user reported directly, and the first impression. Three candidate causes found by reading (none measured): `CatalogPage` fires **two concurrent server round trips** (search + count) on first load; the search query carries a **per-row LATERAL join** (`hosted.rs:2484`); and tiles request full "normal"-size Scryfall images with **no `srcset`**. **The named check:** a browser network waterfall on a cold `/catalog` load plus `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` on the search query at dev-catalog scale. Re-scope from the profile — and note the profile will change materially after `P6-108` loads 116K printings, so take it both before and after.
